job.email_subject: Application: Full Stack Engineer – Product Development
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Retail media products sit where commerce data, APIs and user-facing features meet – exactly my daily work on large commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– OCC REST / headless APIs for storefronts, PWA and third parties
– JavaScript, PWA integration and storefront customization
– 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Java APIs, JavaScript Frontends & Retail Commerce
tailoring.summary: Full stack engineer with 5+ years building and extending large retail and B2B commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Backend strength in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs and microservices, plus JavaScript, PWA integration and storefront customization on the frontend. Experienced with product catalogs, promotions, PIM and ERP data integrations and SQL performance tuning. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles, performs code reviews and uses AI tools daily across development and testing.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Vantage builds retail media products, and retail media depends on solid commerce data and fast APIs. I want to bring five years of commerce engineering – headless APIs, promotions, catalogs and storefronts – into a product development team where I can shape features end to end. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi! Saw your Full Stack Engineer post. 5+ years commerce engineering – Java APIs, JavaScript/PWA frontends, promotions, catalogs – for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Karlsruhe, work permit, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Full Stack Engineer – Product Development
en.hook: Retail media products live where commerce data, APIs and user-facing features meet. That has been my daily work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build APIs, promotions, catalogs and storefront features on large commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Full stack delivery
bullets.text: Built APIs for headless commerce and PWA frontends and customized storefronts and Backoffice components with JavaScript and responsive design.

bullets.label: APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Commerce domain
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) with Java and Spring for product, catalog, pricing and customer data; developed and maintained Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Engineering quality
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit; perform code reviews, support production issues and give technical guidance to junior developers.

en.logistics: I enjoy shipping product features in small, international teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen Vantage.
